programs.description: Born out of wedlock, Vijay grows up with deep resentment towards his biological father Raj, a wealthy industrialist who has been leading a comfortable life with his legitimate family in the big city.
Twins Amit and Kishan are separated at birth. However, when their paths cross in the future, together they work their way through and strive to overcome challenges.
Geeta and her father undergo several hardships to ensure that Prakash gets an education abroad. However, things take a turn when, upon his return, he marries a rich girl.
Vicky plans to marry Aarti, but his dreams are crushed when an incident causes her to lose her life. Fuelled by revenge, Vicky finds himself going down a dark path.
Brothers Prem, Vijay and Ravi are happy, but their lives change when Prem gets killed. Ravi must save his family from an evil man, Dharampal, while Vijay is preoccupied with Sapna.
Raja, a young man, wants an easy life and marries for wealth and comfort. He soon finds out that there is an underlying secret of his wife and feels trapped.
A flood separates childhood friends Seema and Rajesh. Years later, when she reconciles with him and the two plan to get together, things go awry with the arrival of a mysterious woman.
Kailash's uncle discovers a formula to save energy, which could make him very wealthy. Mr Mehta, an industrialist, envies his success and devises an evil plan to steal the formula.
Vishwanath, an honest lawyer, is framed and imprisoned due to a gangster. After his release, he sets out to seek revenge and ends up becoming a criminal.
A factory worker's son needs a heart transplant, but the hospital will not go ahead with it without paying upfront. So, he is forced to take the law into his own hands to save his sick child.

Amar, a rich businessman, is framed by two undercover police officers, Seema and Jagmohan, for the murder of his uncle. To evade prison, he claims to be of unsound mind and tries to solve the mystery.

Shaamu, who lives a carefree life, falls in love with a well-educated girl, Raadha. However, circumstances force the young couple to part ways.
Akash, the son of a lawyer, falls in love with a courtesan when he hears her recite one of his poems. However, a series of obstacles and a mysterious murder threaten to break them apart.
A rich girl runs away from home and settles down with a truck driver. However, her dream life is shattered when she learns that her new lover has been accused of murder.
Yash, Taj and Gaurav fall madly in love with Isha, a beautiful and charming woman. However, Isha is friendly with all three men, unaware of their feelings towards her.
Abhay returns from prison after running over a man and falls for the victim's daughter. However, when her brother sees them in a compromising position, he accuses Abhay of assaulting her.
Ruby ventures into the forest searching for a legendary tribe but encounters Tarzan and falls for him. However, her father and fiancé plot to capture him and sell him to the circus.
Two struggling actors from Punjab who have the same name, Balwinder Singh, come to Mumbai and fall in love with the same woman.
After Major Vijay Malhotra's colleagues betray him, he is branded as a traitor and subsequently killed. But his son, Vicky, vows to take revenge on his father's murderers and prove his innocence.
When an expelled police inspector, an outlaw and a commissioner's son are implicated by a dealer, they unite to seek revenge and prove they are not culprits.

Adarsh and Aniket are two brothers who study in the same college. However, when they graduate and plan to establish a career, both of them choose different paths and gradually drift apart.
A slum-dwelling performer finds a new calling as a rising disco star. However, things take an unfortunate turn when an enemy from the past reappears in his life.
A young man falls for a woman from the red-light district, but their love faces opposition and threat from powerful figures.
A casino owner is trapped by a gangster and forced to work for him. However, when he refuses to kill a commissioner, the gangster abducts his secretary and sister to blackmail him.
Raj, an aspiring singer, rescues Pooja, the daughter of a wealthy man, from an accident. However, he soon finds himself in a web of complications when he falls in love with her best friend.
Kedarnath feels guilty after knowing that the man he replaced at a job has killed himself. For years to come, he goes to great lengths to support the man's family and even ends up stealing for them.
Twins Kishan and Kanhaiya swap their identities so that they can win over Radha. However, Bijli tries to foil their plans as she desperately loves Kishan.
Prem Mehra loses everything after one of his employees joins hands with his rapacious rival and the two plot against him. Later, his sons work together to retrieve their family's lost wealth.
Tony, a burglar, comes under the radar of suspicion when a series of mysterious thefts bewilder the police. Soon enough, he tries to redeem his honour by going after the real criminal.
Hemlata, a princess who is partially paralysed, and her siblings feel stifled in front of their father's orders and protocols. However, things change when a young and jovial doctor enters her life.

A couple's relationship is affected due to the husband's busy work schedule and as soon as the wife tries to make necessary changes in their lifestyle, the lady's former lover enters her life.
Sonam's night of celebration turns into a disaster when her car hits an innocent man. Afraid of being punished for the crime, she decides to hide him but invites trouble in turn.
Friends Shankar and Shambhu share a lot in common and also end up falling in love with the same girl. However, when the girl loves Shankar, Shambhu parts ways with him and joins his rival.
A young man stumbles upon a mysterious woman, who he suspects of being a ghost. However, his worst fears come true when his mother arranges his marriage with the same woman.
Jai, a wealthy businessman in love with Tia, accidentally kills her husband in a car crash. After the accident Tia loses her memory and falls for Jai, who struggles with guilt.
When Asha is unable to conceive and loses her eyesight, her mother-in-law throws her out of the house and arranges for her son to remarry.
Two brothers struggle to keep their family together as external forces like the younger brother's father-in-law try to break them apart.
Gopi, a humble rickshaw puller, faces love and social prejudice as he pursues a relationship with Kiran, a woman from a higher class, challenging societal norms and personal conflicts.

programs.showName: I Proud to Be an Indian
programs.description: I, a man from India, travels to London for a family wedding and finds that their community is being threatened by a racist group. Seeing this, he decides to get involved and fight back.
After the death of his parent, Kunal lives with his grandfather Shamsher. However, when he falls in love with Durga, Shamsher plans to separate them.

The parents of an adopted child face issues of love, betrayal and custody when their daughter's birth mother arrives.
Vijay grows up with a dream of bringing water to his village after his father's sacrifice goes in vain. So, he participates in a kabaddi tournament to attract the attention of the bureaucracy.
When an ordinary man discovers crores in his account, he is thrown into a tangled mess of crime, impersonation and corrupt connections he never asked for.
After being diagnosed with alopecia, a condition that causes rapid hair loss, Enakshi, a young girl, navigates through the trials and tribulations of life.
A son and his father make a bet that soon spirals out of control, especially after Bollywood celebrity Rakhi Sawant and the media frenzy surrounding her get involved.
Shanti and Suraj lead a content life until he abandons her to marry Ruchi. Shanti and Ruchi both give birth to boys, who grow up and fight each other, unaware that they are half-brothers.
A conniving son throws his aged parents out of the house. Years later, he meets the same fate when his son decides to teach him a lesson.
A diligent and determined police officer is tasked with uncovering the truth behind a crooked warden involved in illicit weapon trafficking.
Pandit Girdhari Laal Sharma wants to get his daughter, Radha, married extravagantly but lacks the money for it. He then devises a plan to source the money, unaware of the consequences.

Kalpana, a habitual liar, attempts to sabotage her sister's arranged marriage to a doctor, but complications arise when she develops feelings for him.
After losing his job owing to his arrogance and subsequently his son, Vijay, Atmaram realises his mistake and decides to turn over a new leaf.
Suspecting an extra-marital affair, Vijay, a professor, abandons his wife, Laxmi. However, years later, when he is hurtled back into Laxmi's life through her adopted daughter, things become clearer.
Three men try different methods to woo their neighbour. However, her father wants her to get married to someone from his community.
A jailer's daughter falls for a prisoner poet, believing him wrongly convicted and strives to prove his innocence and secure his release.
Anishka, the daughter of a doctor, is kidnapped, and the abductors demand a hefty ransom. When Dr Viren abides by their rules and delivers the money, the kidnappers vanish with the money and Anishka.
Fueled by a deep desire for revenge, two young boys mature into strong-minded adults and set out to secure the justice denied to their father years ago.
Subir, a singer, encourages his wife, Uma, to pursue a singing career. However, things take a turn when she becomes more popular than him.
Two brothers who excel in boxing are separated in childhood and take different paths after their father, a police officer, is murdered by a gangster.
Mohanlal, a musician and a thief, robs rich people and distributes the money amongst the poor. However, things take a turn when he falls for Sunita, a wealthy man's daughter.

Anand, a rich youngster, denounces his wealth to establish himself independently. However, he keeps struggling in the big city until Renu, a middle-class woman, helps him, and he falls for her.
Babu, who kills a man, is blackmailed by Bhagat into assuming the identity of a wealthy heir, Kundan, for his money. However, things get complicated when Babu falls in love with Kundan's sister.
Upon Prince Pratap's insistence, Rajoo impersonates him in front of Princess Poonam. But the imitation lands him in trouble when she starts falling for Rajoo, unaware of his poor background.
Manisha, a wealthy woman, falls in love with Ajay, a middle-class man, who promises to marry her and settle down within three years. However, after the time period passes, he mysteriously disappears.

programs.showName: Deewaar: Let's Bring Our Heroes Home
programs.description: Haunted by the past, Vijay turns to crime, while Ravi, his younger brother, becomes an honest police officer. Fate pits them against each other when Ravi is sent to nab Vijay.
Pinky, the granddaughter of a wealthy industrialist, runs away and marries a taxi driver. However, the businessman holds Pinky's lover responsible and gets him arrested.
Two siblings, Radha and Ramu, belong to a poor family. Their life takes an unexpected turn when a tragic incident leaves them orphaned.
Brothers Prem, Vijay and Ravi are happy, but their lives change when Prem gets killed. Ravi must save his family from an evil man, Dharampal, while Vijay is preoccupied with Sapna.
Moussa, a mafia leader, gives a bunch of people an opportunity to earn a hefty amount by making them participate in a game of survival.
An idealist elder brother lands in a dilemma after he misplaces his little sister's shoes. Unable to afford a new pair, the siblings agree to share the shoes, leading to several escapades.
